crime_highlights: Mr. Cloud struck Mr. O’Brien with the wooden stick in the jaw or upper cheek bone and on the top of the head.
The force of the blows shattered the tree branch into pieces.
There was a physical struggle with Mr. O’Brien lying face down in the hallway and Mr. Cloud sitting on top of him.
As a result of this confrontation, Mr. O’Brien suffered: a. A cut to the top of his head causing significant bleeding.
rationale_highlights: The Gladue Report indicates that Mr. Cloud’s life has been marked by intergenerational trauma, poverty, substance abuse, and systemic marginalization.
the Gladue factors serve to diminish Mr. Cloud’s moral culpability but only to a degree
He has suffered intergenerational trauma exacerbated by various forms of poverty, physical and sexual abuse, drug addiction, and mental health challenges.
In these circumstances, Mr. Cloud’s diminished moral culpability for the crimes in this case clearly emerges.
